root_causes.condition: Its memory hard limit is 1503238553600m (about 1.5Gi) while already-used requested memory is 1901Mi, so it rejects every replacement ad Pod requesting 225Mi.
root_causes.name: otel-demo-memory

diagnosis.summary: After the sole ad Pod was stopped, ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 repeatedly failed to create its required replacement because ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory was already exceeded. The ad service consequently had no ready endpoint, and frontend requests that depend on it propagated as frontend and frontend-proxy errors.

agent_messages: I’ll inspect the offline capture only, trace failures to the smallest independent Kubernetes causes, and write the requested JSON without altering the snapshot.

The application failure begins when the sole `ad` pod is terminated; its controller then cannot recreate it because the namespace’s memory quota is already over its configured hard limit. I’m validating that this outage is the direct source of the frontend errors before recording the cause.
